cohort: 500 pregnant women undergoing pre-planned caesarean sections at Green Cross Hospital in Lucknow, India between June 2012 and April 2018
finding: Vacuum-assisted caesarean delivery resulted in less uterine incision extension, estimated blood loss, and maternal discomfort compared to manual caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted caesarean delivery was associated with less maternal discomfort.
